verdict.rationale: Convex documents several programmatic surfaces that cover many common dashboard tasks. The CLI can push functions and schema, run queries, mutations and actions, import and export data, stream logs and show health insights. A public HTTP API calls deployment functions, and an official MCP server lets agents interact with deployments. However, nothing documents a management API that matches everything the dashboard does, the probe found no OpenAPI spec, and the MCP server cannot access production by default. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim or management/platform API covering all dashboard operations (e.g. backups, custom domains, log streaming config, project/team management), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of parity.
